visual.general_description: Six-panel histology figure (A to F) of bone marrow and lymph node tissue with hematoxylin-eosin, silver and kappa/lambda immunostains.

Row one (A, B) shows bone marrow: a crowded cellular field with round empty spaces, and a silver-stained field with a black fiber meshwork. Row two (C, D) shows lymph node at low and higher power in purple-pink hematoxylin-eosin staining, with a round cluster of small dark cells in D. Panel letters sit in white boxes at the upper left of each panel; no scale bars or other text are visible.

visual.general_description: Clinical-course figure with treatment bars above three stacked line plots of platelets, hemoglobin, WBC, CRP, albumin and creatinine over weeks.
visual.detailed_description: Treatment bars sit above the top plot: CRRT and HD blocks at the upper left, a long black CyA bar and a long white TCZ bar running to the right edge, a short gray mPSL 1g block and a long gray PSL bar. A downward arrow labelled CPA points at the top plot. Three stacked line plots share a Weeks axis with ticks 1, 5, 10 and 15. The top plot shows Plt (solid, circles, left axis 0 to 15 x10^4/μL) and Hb (dashed, triangles, right axis 0 to 15 g/dL). The middle plot shows WBC (solid, left axis 0 to 25,000 /μL) and CRP (dashed, right axis 0 to 25 mg/dL). The bottom plot shows Alb (solid, left axis 0 to 4 g/dL) and Cre (dashed, right axis 0 to 2.5 mg/dL). No patient names, dates or other identifiers are visible.
